bio_en: Nikol Odabashian was born in Ganja in 1876 and in 1890 moved to Tiflis, where he learned a trade and joined an ARF youth circle. In 1896 he went to Baku, combining devotion to the Armenian cause with the workers' struggle, and by 1903 had taken part in several assassinations and been imprisoned; in 1903 he joined the armed defence of the Baku Armenian church under Nikol Duman. He fought in the Armenian-Tatar clashes of 1905-06 around Yerevan and Nakhichevan and then ran arms to Vaspurakan, working in Van until he went to America in 1909. Returning in 1917, he was badly wounded as an army officer in the 1920 Turkish-Armenian war and, half-invalided, died in America in 1943.
